# v2026.10.16

<!-- Written by scripts/release/changelog.mjs from CHANGELOG/2026.10.16.md. Do not edit it: the release cut writes it again. -->

AI agents and tools can read these release notes as [plain Markdown](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/arcforgelabs/field/main/CHANGELOG/2026.10.16.md).

This release covers **9 pull requests.**

## Highlights

- Owners see and revoke command-line tokens and connected agents in Settings, Team, Access. ([#146](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/field/pull/146))
- Owners see in Settings when a newer Field release is out. ([#140](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/field/pull/140))
- A Replit deployment can follow the stable or the beta release channel. ([#139](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/field/pull/139))
- The job header keeps its actions on one row, and the more-actions menu opens under its button. ([#137](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/field/pull/137))
- A release survives npm's delay and a private image, and promote can point beta again. ([#138](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/field/pull/138))

## Changes

- A Replit deployment can follow the stable or beta release channel. ([#139](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/field/pull/139))
- Owners see and revoke command-line tokens and connected agents in Settings, Team, Access. ([#146](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/field/pull/146))
- Owners see in Settings when a newer Field release is out. ([#140](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/field/pull/140))

## Fixes

- A release survives npm's propagation lag and a private image, and promote can re-point beta. ([#138](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/field/pull/138))
- The job header keeps its actions on one row and opens the more-actions menu under its button. ([#137](https://github.com/arcforgelabs/field/pull/137))
